title: How to play
note: Games at Beercade average $2 or 2 tokens. Buy tokens and save.

items.name: Solo
items.description: 5 tokens.

items.name: Quickie
items.description: 10 tokens.

items.name: Party Pack
items.description: 20 tokens, plus 2 extra.

items.name: Gamer Pack
items.description: 50 tokens, plus 10 extra.

items.name: Group Pack
items.description: 100 tokens, plus 25 extra.

items.name: God Mode
items.description: 200 tokens, plus 60 extra.

items.name: Winner's Pack
items.description: 300 tokens, plus 150 extra.

items.name: Super Saver
items.description: 500 tokens, plus 350 extra.

footnotes: Once tokens have been purchased, they cannot be cashed in for real money.
Tokens can only be used on machines at Beercade or any other participating venues.
